Jordan H: Quick UX question — for the automatic failover behavior we sketched last week, should the console show who triggered the switch (system policy vs manual) and let an SRE set a short manual rollback TTL override?
Maria L: Yes, we should surface an immutable audit event for each switch + link to the exact policy/rule. otherwise we lose context.
Alex P: Agreed. Proposed UI: per-route 'sensitivity' slider (low/med/high) + a compact dropdown to set `rollback window` (5m/30m/2h/custom). Show a badge: `Triggered by: policy / manual (user)` with a clickable event id.
Sam K: If we allow manual overrides, require a short reason field (1-line) and record user identity. prevents silent flips. :lock: @Maria L @Alex P
Jordan H: good — also want a TTL clamp so people can't set forever. default should be 30m, max 24h and only org-admins can extend.
Alex P: here's a sketch of the config we'd persist (backend):
```json
{
  "route": "/chat/completions",
  "fallback_policy": {
    "sensitivity": "high",
    "rollback_ttl_minutes": 30,
    "allow_manual_override": true,
    "manual_override_max_minutes": 1440,
    "audit_required_fields": ["user_id","reason","event_id"]
  }
}
```
Maria L: Nice. Two follow-ups: 1) telemetry: emit `fallback.event` with `trigger=policy|manual` + `event_id` so we can tie to dashboard graphs. 2) Quotas: if fallback routes to a cheaper model that has a separate quota, UI must show projected quota impact/cost delta before confirm.
Sam K: On quotas — show an inline estimate and a yellow warning if the fallback will exceed monthly quota burn by >10%. Also, fallback shouldn't automatically bypass rate-limits; it should respect per-model quotas.
Alex P: Implementation note: audit log entries need immutable timestamps and a read-only history view. We should add a row-level link to the console trace that opens the full event JSON.
Jordan H: UX question: where to surface the manual rollback button? inline on route detail + in the rollout timeline. Manual action should be gated behind `require reason` and show the last 3 events for context.
Maria L: +1. Also add a ‘preview impact’ modal that shows token estimate / latency delta. Product wants the cost delta visible for finance signoff flows.
Sam K: For security, only allow manual rollback if the user has `rollout:modify` permission. We'll need an admin audit to allow extending max TTL.
Alex P: I can wire the console bits if design hands us the modal copy. I'll stub the API endpoints: `POST /api/routes/:id/override` + `GET /api/routes/:id/audit` and include event_id in responses.
deploy-bot: rollout-service v2.14.0 deployed to staging — smoke tests passed. :white_check_mark:
Jordan H: Great — action items: Alex to prototype modal + endpoints, Maria to spec telemetry event fields, Sam to add RBAC checks, I'll draft the console copy and TTL clamp text. Aim for staging demo next Wed. :calendar:
